No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The globe section retains anterior cornea on the left, two iris pieces separated by an open pupil, the lens behind them, inner posterior retinal lining and the posterior optic-nerve exit. Iris strips are independently widened to 8.4 mm and moved posteriorly; the lens is also moved 9 mm posteriorly to preserve their separation and keep the pupil open. Contiguous retinal-exit/nerve lines are authored as single continuous paths; no optical rays or vessel overlay is added. Contiguous retinal-exit/nerve lines are authored as single continuous paths; no optical rays or vessel overlay is added.
